interface_changes: 新增只读 CLI：m-model runs compare <left> <right>。JSON 输出包含 protocol、dimensions、summary 和 read_only/causal_attribution 标记；普通终端逐项显示相同/有差异/信息不足。
latest 统一按 started_at_ms 解析；runs list 的状态分组排序不再影响 runs show、try --repeat latest 或 train --resume latest 的最近语义。
implementation: 对照运行输入、源码清单、数据/采样、预算、设备、权重和指标；每个维度逐项标记 same/changed/unknown。
协议/指标/设备/权重缺失时显式显示 unknown；旧运行记录仍可比较。
比较只读，不启动 worker、不重新训练、不声称观测差异的因果来源。
普通终端不泄漏完整配置值；完整字段详情通过 --json 查看。

validation.result: passed: complete Rust workspace suite, 86 unit tests, 43 CLI tests, and all integration test binaries.
passed: 3 tests for latest timestamp semantics, protocol mismatch, missing metrics, and unknown evidence.
passed: JSON and human CLI comparison from persisted records, changed source/data/metrics, unknown inputs/weights, and newest failed run selection.
passed: command exposes two required run IDs and read-only comparison help.
passed: 63 worker modules and embedded asset coverage.
passed: Rust/Python protocol, API, state formats and required features match.

limitations: 比较只报告持久化运行证据；旧记录和训练器未上报的设备、权重或指标标记为 unknown。
CLI-12 的交互式结果浏览和筛选仍未完成。
比较不证明设置差异造成指标变化，也不替代同条件实验设计。
integration_patch: Product command contract and acceptance ledger CMD-runs now include read-only comparison; source document versions synchronized to 0.13.48.
